title: Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan Jewelry Cap When a Duplicate Payment Is Re-Settled
content:
These questions are answered from the jewelry rule for re-settling a Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan claim on which a duplicate payment was made.

**What caps jewelry, furs and watches?**
The duplicate re-settlement's jewelry cap: the level's jewelry, furs and watches sublimit multiplied by 1.5 when the plan's effective date is 36 or more whole months before the loss date, by 1.2 when it is at least 12 and fewer than 36 whole months before the loss date, and by 1 otherwise.

**What is measured?**
Whole months from the plan's effective date to the claim's loss date.

**Thresholds in figures.** 36 whole months or more: 1.5. From 12 to 35 whole months: 1.2. Fewer than 12: 1.

**Worked figure (hypothetical).** A sublimit of 1,350.00 and a plan effective 8 whole months before the loss date give a cap of 1,350.00; at 30 whole months, 1,620.00; at 48, 2,025.00.
